about: The tractus of the formulary “Purification of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, we ponder Your kindness within Your temple. As Your name, O God, so also Your praise reaches to the ends of the earth. As we have heard so have we seen, in the city of our God, in His holy mountain. Now You dismiss Your servant, O Lord, according to Your word, in peace. Because my eyes have seen Your salvation. Which You have prepared before the face of all peoples. A light of revelation to the Gentiles, and a glory for Your people Israel.
